acceptanceCriteria.text: Capture contracts and hash-verified item durations are documented and packaged; native successful speedups update matching timers and known inventory once, preserving stale/newer snapshots and account isolation.
Building, Research and Hospital expose item/quantity preview and a separate confirmation with target, spend and duration; cancellation or stale target/inventory/account never spends.
Pending spends are serialized and persist through popup close/restart; queued acknowledgement or timeout does not trigger duplicate/retry or optimistic timer changes.
Only observed dedicated-item payloads are sent with exact feature/args and no paid/refund guesses; unknown Training and overrun behavior are tracked.
Replay, reducer, real component confirmation, background and Direct/Piggyback regressions plus full tests/typecheck/build pass.

checkpointPayload.description: Analyze hwa-game-record-202611151039_user_speedup.json for healing/building/research resource speedups, reduce timers and inventory exactly once from confirmed responses, and expose manual speedup controls with an explicit user confirmation before every spend. Keep shared RPC/account/queue safeguards; record unobserved training/overrun contracts as future capture work.
checkpointPayload.implementationPlan: 1. Extract sanitized speedup contracts and verify cached config hashes/durations, including queue baselines. 2. Package duration data and shared validation/target/planning helpers. 3. Add confirmed speedup reduction, bounded receipts and post-action authoritative reads; serialize persisted manual spend in background. 4. Add reusable select/preview/confirm control to Building/Research/Hospital, revalidate before dispatch and hold uncertain spends. 5. Test exact native captures, stale/replay/account/inventory guards, confirmation cancellation and bridge modes; run full checks and build. 6. Document contracts, record missing capture tasks and durable decision candidate, then validate and complete.
checkpointPayload.title: Add confirmed speedup use and synchronize queue timers
